article.hook: Someone cuts in front of you in line and you don’t let it slide. The North Node in Aries pulls you toward acting on your own behalf, even if it feels new or sharp. It’s about starting before you’re sure it’s your turn, and owning that move.
article.lived: For the next year and a half, we’re living with a collective prompt to lead with guts. It shows up in moments like volunteering first for a project no one else wants, or speaking up when your idea is half-formed and likely to ruffle feathers. This isn’t about waiting for permission or polishing your ask; it’s about taking your space in the conversation and deciding what you want before you’re certain how or if it fits.
article.turn: The problem hits when acting first becomes acting without check - interrupting, bulldozing, or steamrolling others in the name of ‘taking charge.’ The energy that pushes you to lead can fracture trust when it ignores the room and leans on impatience. If you don’t test the impulse by listening, you’ll only learn how loud you can be, not where you belong.
moves: Speak up in the next meeting before you’ve fully formulated your point.
Volunteer to lead a task no one else has claimed, even if it’s outside your comfort zone.
Say no to a request that drains you without hesitation, without overexplaining.
